scope: Original-clause compound intent, unsupported suggestion rejection, validated partial proposal and explicit confirmation, remaining request continuity and retained v1-v5 behavior

limitations: Both revisions and five iframe dimensions were exercised. jsdom does not verify responsive pixel layout, clipping or visual appearance.

The upload is a local FormData demonstration and the background progression uses labelled fixture timers. No real files were uploaded to a server, no external AI was invoked, and Blender was not executed.

notes: Partial proposals are not applied until the separate explicit confirmation API is called; confirmation reuses the stored candidate and never calls an AI provider.
Known original task blockers are retained; unrequested bevel, microtexture and independent-shadow suggestions trigger a bounded correction rather than silent omission.
Version, real source image, target sampling and scene guards prevent a saved proposal from being applied to changed evidence. Read-only diagnostic timestamps do not invalidate geometry evidence.
Remaining original clauses and applicable preservation constraints survive partial application; completed relative edits are not replayed as new intent.
Public project responses hide service-private candidate plans and evidence digests.
Real hidden-wheel completeness and actual provider semantic accuracy remain unbenchmarked; trusted surface samples do not prove unseen geometry.
The source .env is preserved byte-for-byte in the full source archive and excluded from the cumulative patch; actual configuration contents were not read by the test harness.
The two historical missing-fixture errors are not counted as passes.
Offline interactions and images are explicitly simulated. jsdom viewport checks do not establish browser pixel layout or render appearance.
